name: Purify Food and Drink

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Nonmagical food/drink in 5-foot-radius sphere becomes free of poison/rot; retain actual item quantities and original identity; no removal of unrelated magical effects.

rules.text: You remove poison and rot from nonmagical food and drink in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range.

runtime_draft.coverage: Unverified. Neither a full definition nor a fragment certifies all source rules or controls. Required extensions are not silently waived.

required_extensions.requirement: Create/consume/purify real measured quantities with exact ownership, containers, expiry and source outcomes, not descriptive substitutes.
required_extensions.spell_specific_intent: Nonmagical food/drink in 5-foot-radius sphere becomes free of poison/rot; retain actual item quantities and original identity; no removal of unrelated magical effects.
required_extensions.note: This is an authored handoff requirement, not a fresh runtime failure or claim that the whole referenced slice is missing.

integration.promotion: Reconcile every source rule and required extension, then implement and verify through production paths before any deliberate promotion. Keep native behavior until covered.
